description: Test suite for IRC control character helper functions: 'hasIrcControlChars', 'isIrcControlChar', and 'stripIrcControlChars'. It verifies detection and removal of IRC control characters in strings.

methods.name: hasIrcControlChars
methods.description: Checks if the given string contains IRC control characters.

methods.name: isIrcControlChar
methods.description: Determines if a given codepoint is an IRC control character.

methods.name: stripIrcControlChars
methods.description: Removes IRC control characters from the input string.
